tasks.label: Build Rubrica.jar
tasks.command: $javaHome = $env:JAVA_HOME; if (-not $javaHome) { $javaHome = 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-21' }; if (-not (Test-Path "$javaHome\bin\jar.exe")) { throw "jar.exe non trovato in $javaHome\bin" }; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force bin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force bin | Out-Null; $sorgenti = Get-ChildItem -Path rubrica -Recurse -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object FullName; javac -cp "lib\*" -d bin $sorgenti; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$javaHome\bin\jar.exe" cfm Rubrica.jar manifest.mf -C bin .
